rows.new: A waist-high plinth in the ruin's own pale stone, two turns of runes cut around it in the hand that cut the ruin's. The lines all run inward and not one of them comes back out.

rows.old: Quietly, if you can manage it. I have lost the count twice already and blamed you both times.
rows.new: Quiet, for a moment. I am tracing a line I cannot see. If I lose it I will blame you, and we will both know I am lying.
rows.round2_first_pass_new: Do not talk to me for a moment. I am at the ninth turn of it and I would rather not begin again.

rows.new: Two of them, down on their knuckles where the tunnel narrows: moon-grey, shouldered like the rock behind them. Their eyes hold on you and the tunnel keeps dropping away past their feet.

rows.new: The passage opens into a pillared gallery with no far wall in your light. The floor is packed smooth and hollowed along the lines the pacing takes. Far back, eyes pick up the light and are gone before you can count them.

rows.old: Nothing else glints in the nest today.
